lines.text: What if all the *air* on Earth disappeared... for five seconds?
Right now, about *ten tonnes* of air is pressing down on every square meter of you.
Total *silence*. Sound is just moving air.
Pigeons drop like stones. Their wings have nothing to push.
The sky turns *black* at noon. Blue sky is just sunlight bouncing off air.
And you? You'd stay awake for about ten seconds. But the spit on your tongue would start to *boil*.
Then the air slams back. Your ears *pop*.
Follow for more. What should vanish next?
